service.method: SELECT HOUSE_CODE , COMPANY_CODE , COMPANY_NAME FROM USERVICE WHERE 1=1 AND COMPANY_CODE = '1000' AND HOUSE_CODE = $S{HOUSE_CODE} AND #DB_OWNER#NVL(DEL_FLAG, 'N') = 'N' AND ( 1=1 AND UPPER(HOUSE_CODE) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR UPPER(COMPANY_NAME) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' )

SELECT MODULE, LAST_EXECUTE_DATE, LAST_EXECUTE_TIME, MODULE_NAME, RFC_NAME, DEL_FLAG, PROCESS_ID, METHOD_NAME, HOUSE_CODE FROM SIFLH WHERE 1 = 1 AND #DB_OWNER#NVL( DEL_FLAG, 'N' ) = 'N' AND HOUSE_CODE = ${HOUSE_CODE} AND ( 1=1 AND UPPER(MODULE) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR UPPER(MODULE_NAME) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR UPPER(PROCESS_ID) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' OR UPPER(METHOD_NAME) LIKE '%' + UPPER($S{F_KEYWORD}) + '%' ) ORDER BY MODULE

INSERT INTO SIFLH ( MODULE, LAST_EXECUTE_DATE, LAST_EXECUTE_TIME, MODULE_NAME, RFC_NAME, DEL_FLAG, PROCESS_ID, METHOD_NAME, HOUSE_CODE ) VALUES ( ${MODULE}, ${current.DATE}, ${current.TIME}, ${MODULE_NAME}, ${RFC_NAME}, 'N', ${PROCESS_ID}, ${METHOD_NAME}, ${HOUSE_CODE} )
